the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Apply lemma-quasi-finite-over-base to the groupoid (U, R, s, t, c) over S with points p and u, obtaining an etale neighbourhood (S', p') to (S, p), disjoint union decompositions S' times_S U = U' coprod W and S' times_S R = R' coprod W', and u' in U' satisfying conclusions (a) through (g). The neighbourhood may be shrunk without affecting (a) through (g). Let j' be the base change of j to S'. By conclusion (e) the inverse image j'^{-1}(U' times_{S'} U') decomposes as R' coprod Rest with Rest open and closed. Since U' to S' is finite by conclusion (d), U' times_{S'} U' is finite over S'; since j is universally closed, so is j', and hence j' restricted to Rest is universally closed. Conclusions (b) and (c) show the fibre of (U' times_{S'} U' to S') composed with j'|_Rest over p' is empty; as Rest to S' is closed, replacing S' by S' minus the image of Rest to S' makes Rest empty, which is exactly the condition that R' is the restriction of S' times_S R to U', by the restrict-groupoid-relation lemma and its proof. (source lines 2585-2622)
